privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; fixtures are invented. The read-only GitHub token lives only in a file on the hosting base. Component repositories are read, never written; agents never touch ~/.nerv, ~/.nerv-app or the live NERV service.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: S3: poller for the nine repositories (main, PRs, CI, harness versions, audit dates)
goal: The cache follows GitHub within minutes of a merge, read-only
acceptance: failing tests first, on a fake GitHub client: conditional requests with ETags (a 304 costs no rebuild), a new commit on a `main` or a new CI result rebuilds only that repository; PRs and CI results stored (the builder's `prs` rows, read at each rebuild)

polls every 5 minutes; reads a read-only fine-grained token (contents, pull requests, actions: read) from a file on the base, never from git; a missing token is a clear error, not empty data; local `rebuild` needs none
an unreadable repository shows as unknown, never as no work
harness versions and audit dates moved to F-024-T09 (2026-11-27): the builder's schema has no column for them

effort.basis: Decision page S3 row. Estimated 2026-11-26 from the decision page's step table (docs/decisions/live-index.md, "Steps, if approved"), at agent speed, failing test first for code. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-27: src/poller.mjs (three conditional GETs per repository: main's commit, the 30 most recently updated PRs, the 30 latest Actions runs; new ETags kept only after that repository's rebuild succeeds), rebuildOne in src/live-index.mjs (copy the cache, rebuild one repository through buildRemote, move it over), serve polls with the token file (default <data>/github-token, --token <file>); test/poller.test.mjs committed failing first; owner token steps in docs/live-index-install.md. Closes after the PR merges on green CI.

validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
